segment.source: Renders one large sentence across the full width of the page, with an optional supporting line beneath it and nothing else competing for attention. Use it for: a mission statement, the promise that opens a section, a manifesto line between two chapters, a closing thought at the end of a report. Prefer 'Pull Quote' when the words belong to a named person, and 'Callout' when the sentence is a caveat rather than a claim.
